findings.text: the comment names a plan section number instead of the mechanism ("the tier the §2 rule gives it"; "§2" is written as the plan-section glyph), which the source rules forbid in new lines: a test must stand alone without plan context and the number rots when the plan renumbers; state the rule's home (reckon/review_tiers.py) instead.

ESCALATED_TIER is defined and read nowhere in the tree — git grep for the name at 9701e873 returns only this line — so the escalation the comment beside it names has no consumer and no test; the section's two nodes own no caller for it, so drop the constant until the dispatch path that escalates lands, or have that caller read it.
